question: Which source studies, preparation/capture limitations, overlap and missing joins can be recovered from one SCAHN public FAQ and directly linked source-table pass?
decision: Replace the source-table-access hold with recovered Table S1 and source leads, while holding expression until exact source/donor/preparation/measurement-mask joins qualify.
strongest_rival: Treating atlas study labels or tissue/condition marginal counts as independent donors or a joint healthy whole-blood cohort, and treating unmeasured genes encoded as zero as observed absence.
discriminator: Extract Table S1 only; preserve source row/DOI and marginal counts. Compare source study IDs with fixed reused publications and FAQ dataset splits. Do not infer cell/donor overlap or whole-blood preparation from technology alone.
exposure_record: Primary article XML, FAQ/home and workbook sheet names/header/representative Table S1 rows were inspected before freeze. This is exposed metadata qualification. No gene query, expression page, raw atlas download or expression extraction.
biological_unit: Reported mouse samples for X3; public studies and their reported sample counts for X5. Exact animal/donor identities are unresolved.
nesting_and_overlap: Cells nest in reported samples; samples can share donors and studies. Reused Salcher and Ravel source studies are not independent replication.
population_and_selection: All populated source-study rows in Supplementary Table S1; lung/peripheral-blood leads and fixed Salcher2022/Adams2020/Habermann2020 direct study matches. Other workbook sheets are outside extraction.
contrast: Public source and unit availability only, not healthy/disease expression comparison.
endpoint: Exact source-study row map, reported sample/cell count metadata, lung/blood source leads, direct/possible indirect study reuse, absent sample/donor and gene-measurement joins.
methods: Standard-library OOXML read of Table S1, preserving ten source columns and row locators. Separate marginal tissue/group source leads from unavailable joint cohorts. Read recorded public FAQ facts and bind all retrieval receipts; independent openpyxl Table S1 comparison after run.
missingness_and_exclusions: Preserve source blanks; skip only non-study notes lacking numeric cell/sample counts and record those notes. Missing standalone parent-study rows do not exclude indirect reuse. No inference of unprovided accession, donor or preparation identity.
multiplicity: Not applicable: source metadata and availability only, no biological effect tests.
precision_basis: No population effect estimated. Eligibility and metadata counts are not power calculations.
interpretation_limit: Source metadata are not an independent cohort or raw expression support. Atlas means include encoded unmeasured zeros; source-by-gene measurement and capture must be qualified before any zero/detection comparison. Table margins cannot identify joint healthy tissue samples.
stop_rule: End this bounded access pass after Table S1/source and FAQ qualification. No target-expression query, full atlas download, extra unbounded source search or numerical expression comparison.
amendment_reason: New authorized checkpoint-B source follow-up, preserving X0 and every frozen result.
